text:
emma: Heads-up: tenant `Nimbus` onboarding failing on SCIM create. We get 400 invalid displayName bytes and KMS unwrap complaining about bad header. Repro in staging.

praveen: paste the minimal logs? staging or prod?

emma: staging logs: 
```
2025-03-14T10:12:33Z scim-provisioner ERROR tenant=Nimbus POST /scim/v2/Users 400 {\"detail\":\"invalid displayName bytes\"}
2025-03-14T10:12:33Z kms-client ERROR tenant=Nimbus unwrap: invalid header 0x7e (unexpected)
```

ryan: 0x7e is weird, we've seen 0x01/0x81 before. Any recent KMS alias rewraps or client lib bumps?

laura: infra shows an automated rewrap job last week ran for many tenants; but Nimbus was excluded. No alias change recorded for Nimbus. Could be payload mangled.

praveen: can you capture the raw SCIM payload and the envelope before we call KMS? Also check if the IdP is sending base64url ("-_/" chars) instead of standard base64 and whether padding is omitted. base64url differences can change raw bytes.

emma: captured both. Raw displayName from IdP (hex): `ef bb bf 4a 6f 68 6e cc 81` — looks like there's a BOM (EF BB BF) at the start for some reason + decomposed accent. Our normal pipeline strips BOMs but only in one code path.

ryan: BOM + decomposed accent explains different header: if we re-encrypt a payload that includes a BOM vs one that has been stripped, KMS sees different envelope which can lead to unwrap failures after rewrap. And base64url/padding variance could further mutate bytes if middleware normalizes incorrectly.

incident-bot: [alert] scim-provisioning-failure tenant=Nimbus incident=INC-20250314-72

laura: immediate mitigations: 1) pause any rewraps/alias rollouts for tenants in the pending-migration set; 2) add early-stage normalization that strips UTF-8 BOM and applies NFC to displayName before any compression/envelope; 3) accept both standard base64 and base64url in the saml/oidc adapters (with strict normalization to padded standard base64 before downstream processing).

praveen: agree. Also add an extra KMS unwrap diagnostic: on unwrap failure, log the first 16 bytes (hex) of the envelope payload (redacted) so we can see header mismatch without logging PII.

emma: applied a quick patch to staging: early BOM strip + NFC normalize in the SCIM adapter. Replayed the failing request and it now succeeds.

ryan: good. For RBAC: Nimbus is using displayName->role fallback in a legacy mapping. If we normalize displayName bytes we might break existing mappings. We should immediately add a mapping fallback that prefers `externalId` then `email`, and only uses displayName as a last-resort with an audit flag.

laura: I'm making a short runbook: 
- freeze KMS rewraps for pending tenants (ops)
- patch deployed to staging (emma) — verified
- schedule prod deploy with 15m maintenance window (laura)
- add regression tests for BOM + NFD/NFC + base64url cases in SCIM harness (praveen)
- audit change to RBAC mapping to prefer externalId/email (ryan)

praveen: will also run a binary diff tool on the pre- and post-rewrap envelopes and share hexdump in the incident doc. Expect header byte differences: 0x01 vs 0x7e in our sample.

deploy-bot: [deploy] staging: scim-adapter bom-strip-nfc patch deployed at 2025-03-14T10:45:00Z

ryan: long-term: RFC to ban BOMs in IdP attributes, require canonical base64 in SAML/OIDC integration docs, and fully migrate RBAC mappings off displayName. Add a KMS migration validator that samples rewraps to catch header drift.

emma: assigning owners: praveen (envelope diff + tests), laura (prod deploy timeline + ops coordination), ryan (RBAC migration ticket). I'll draft the postmortem after prod run. Thanks folks.

laura: will open vendor ticket with the IdP asking them to stop emitting BOMs and to prefer NFC-normalized attributes. We'll include reproducible examples from staging audit.

emma: will follow up here once prod goes green. :thumbsup:
